promotion_rules: The target capability must improve against the declared parent checkpoint.
No priority language may regress by more than 2 percentage points.
Report macro average, p10 language, and minimum language; macro alone cannot hide a weak tail.
Non-compensatory safety, privacy, license, and release-artifact gates must pass independently.
Absolute targets remain provisional until an immutable base-checkpoint baseline is recorded.

protected_evaluation_policy.gate_rule: A suite is gate-eligible only when split identity, hashes, access controls, and training-overlap checks are recorded.
protected_evaluation_policy.public_benchmark_rule: If exact benchmark items or derivatives entered training or RLVR, report the score as diagnostic and use an untouched holdout for promotion.
